summary: Creates a cylinder or tube as rows and columns of points, with separate bottom/top radii for tapered tubes, optional arcs/end caps, and connectivity as points, rows, columns, lines, triangles, alternating triangles, or quads.

key_params.name: linetype
key_params.note: Line strip or lines output for line modes

key_params.name: modifybounds
key_params.note: Use input bounds as initial tube bounds

key_params.name: anchoru
key_params.note: Anchor left, middle, or right side at X=0

key_params.name: anchorv
key_params.note: Anchor bottom, middle, or top side at Y=0

key_params.name: anchorw
key_params.note: Anchor back, middle, or front side at Z=0

key_params.name: angleu
key_params.note: Begin and end angle for a partial cylinder arc

key_params.name: endcaps
key_params.note: Add primitives to cap tube ends without changing point dimensions

common_gotchas: Tube POP emits dimension metadata numCols by numRows; keep it intact for _Dim indexing and Connectivity POP.
End caps add primitives while preserving point dimensions, so topology count changes without point count changes.
Rows and columns line modes are useful for visualizing construction but are not the same as renderable surface quads.
